appointment.terms_description: Booking an appointment is a paid session intended for clients who need a live discussion before proceeding. It is typically suitable if you: prefer to explain your matter verbally due to extensive details, want to get to know the firm before assigning any work, or have multiple matters/cases and need to define the direction and priorities. If your required service is available in the website's service list, you can receive a fee quote by submitting a Legal Service Request; therefore, this option is more appropriate than booking an appointment.
